results.name: CODE controls mount once and preserve the project editor until explicitly opened
File pickers explicitly override the shell file-input hiding rule
Example entry is accessible, editable and builds through the CODE UI
Native edits preserve originals and immediately invalidate an earlier build
File and folder imports preserve relative folders and failed replacement retains work
Saved JSON opens atomically and unknown project JSON cannot replace source files
Build settings determine header and changes make prior exports unavailable
Exports use Save As with workspace, preserved source ZIP, ROM, source and symbols
Diagnostics name included files and imported names stay literal DOM text
Source keyboard input is isolated without preventing native editing defaults
Intervening native edits reject a pending file or workspace replacement atomically
Intervening source build settings reject a pending import without losing the new setting
Later import wins when an earlier asynchronous file read resolves afterwards
